title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Interior Works variant
description: Variant for fit-out / renovation / interior-design works. Adds the trade subscope (drives which contractor's package the defect falls under) and the renovation permit number for owner-corporation / regulatory traceability.

trade_subscope.description: Fine-grained trade subscope of the affected work. Routes the defect to the right interior-fit-out subcontractor's punch list.

permit_no.description: Renovation / fit-out permit reference (free text). Empty when no permit applies.
